product.name: AI-Powered Accounts Receivable Automation
product.description: Automates invoicing, cash application, and collections processes using AI to streamline accounts receivable workflows.

product.name: Automated Invoicing and Contract Parsing
product.description: Transforms sales contracts into accurate invoices automatically, handling complex billing terms and multi-currency scenarios.

product.name: Automated Cash Application
product.description: Automatically matches incoming payments to invoices across various payment methods, reducing manual reconciliation efforts.

product.name: Automated Collections and Payment Reminders
product.description: Manages collections by sending timely, automated payment reminders and escalating overdue accounts through intelligent workflows.

identifier.value: AI-Driven Predictive Analytics and Cash Flow Forecasting
